nodes.question: What are some potential benefits of real-time monitoring of water and wastewater resources in cities?
nodes.answer: Real-time monitoring can lead to efficient management of water distribution and wastewater systems and enhance accessibility to safe drinking water in water-stressed areas.

nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What was the water level in Kakhovka Reservoir before the explosion?
nodes.answer: The water level in Kakhovka Reservoir was around 17.5 m above sea level before the explosion.
nodes.paragraph: The water level in Kakhovka Reservoir was around 17.5 m above sea level before explosion, and around 90% of the reservoir was drained after dam breach.
